correctness.rationale: Constructed exact nonempty face set as the union of ten-neighborhood simplices for 21 edges of K7; independent enumeration reproduces 18,494 faces and f-vector (21,210,1190,3780,5187,4410,2520,945,210,21). Rebuilt greedy matching with 9,120 paired covers, 1 critical vertex, 246 critical 3-cells and 7 critical 4-cells; independently oriented all 98,805 Hasse covers and topologically sorted every nonempty face to establish acyclicity. Recursive signed unit-pivot elimination verifies the full 246x7 integral Morse boundary is zero. Since pi3(wedge S3)=Z^246, zero degrees imply nullhomotopic attaching maps and a wedge of S3/S4, not just Betti numbers. Independent construction of seven unimodular top cycles (supports 6,36x6) and their images under six adjacent permutations verifies H4=sgn tensor Z7_perm integrally; quotient rational invariants follow. Finite computation is exhaustive for this fixed finite T7, no infinite claim.
